 North West EDs set to be busy over Bank Holiday weekend
 North West EDs set to be busy over Bank Holiday weekend
 October 23, 2026, 08:03 
 Share this article 
 Copy link 
 Share on X 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on WhatsApp 
 The HSE is advising people in Sligo, Leitrim and South Donegal to be aware of their healthcare options this October Bank Holiday weekend.
 There’s a warning Emergency Departments will be busy over the coming days.
 This October Bank Holiday Weekend, as always, people who do require emergency care are encouraged to attend Emergency Department where they will be prioritised.
 When there is a large volume of ED attendances, patients are prioritised in terms of clinical need and wait times for non-urgent care can be lengthy.
 Advertisement 
 Patients presenting with non-urgent injuries may face longer waiting times, depending on the number of patients attending and the severity of patient illnesses at the time in the ED.
 In a statement John Fitzmaurice, HSE Integrated Healthcare Area Manager for Sligo, Leitrim, South Donegal and West Cavan says Bank Holiday weekends can bring additional pressure on Emergency Departments and staff are working to ensure services are prepared to respond to increased attendances.
 Many common illnesses can be treated at home but if someone may need an urgent GP appointment over the weekend, the out of hours GP service in this region is called Caredoc and NowDoc.
 The service is open all weekend, but an appointment needs to be made in advance.
 Advertisement 
 Local pharmacies can also offer expert advice on a wide range of common illnesses and complaints
 Catherine Gaffney
